report:
Fresh review of the current claim, three ordinary implementation entries and complete associated test set. The claim requires balanced lifecycle spans for every tracked invocation, entry before memo lookup including already-current reuse, and exit on execution, validation, reuse, cancellation or unwinding. No qualifications in the claim remove the warm or failure paths.

Implementation: the src/inspector.rs association connects LiveInspectionProvider::record to build_dynamic_trace after draining inspection events. The associated crates/sage-host/src/trace.rs implementation pushes QueryEnter nodes and matches QueryExit keys, maps Executed/Validated/Reused/Cancelled exhaustively and attaches completed nodes to the current parent. Leaf coalescing retains observations and disposition. Diagnostic fallback for malformed events does not itself establish balanced producers. The associated crates/sage-ir/src/db.rs implementation receives WillRequest/DidRequest and emits corresponding QueryEnter/QueryExit; repeated adjacent complete leaf pairs alone are compacted, retaining multiplicity. Raw observers run before this compaction and are documented to retain failures as data rather than panic.

Captured vendor/salsa/src/function/fetch.rs is the essential producer dependency: fetch calls refresh_memo_traced; that function emits WillRequest and installs RequestGuard before revision cancellation and refresh_memo, which performs the memo lookup. The guard starts with Cancelled, so cancellation and unwinding emit DidRequest through Drop. Successful refresh sets the final disposition before dropping the guard. fetch_hot returns Reused for already-current memos and Validated for shallow revision validation; fetch_cold returns Validated for successful validation and Executed for execution. Cycle recovery returns a disposition or unwinds through the same guard. Nested calls each install a guard and close in stack order. Captured vendor/salsa/src/function/accumulated.rs shows the initial tracked fetch and the accumulator graph's internal refresh both use the traced path, covering otherwise-hidden memo reuse. Both vendored dependencies are explicitly captured because they are outside the workspace association inventory. Current source supports the lifecycle requirements.

Tests: the entire associated test set is the sole TODO function sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_balanced_traces. It has no executable assertions and does not verify any lifecycle behavior. Its explicit prerequisite is to associate and review complete evidence for cold execution, warm reuse, edited validation, nested spans, panicking queries, cancellation before fetch, all four terminal dispositions, and accumulator traversal. This remains an accepted, visible evidence-integration deferral. It is not ordinary passing coverage and this review does not promote it. For example, bypassing the guard on a hot memo or losing the exit during panic would require the deferred entry/exit assertions to detect it; the placeholder cannot. No N/A evidence exists. No source edits or behavioral tests were performed in this refresh; the root runs central validation separately. Commands executed here were fresh review start, dependency reads and record. No implementation defect was identified and no edits beyond the declared TODO evidence work are requested.
